root-only state records tie every active stream to a worker PID, worker start time, job ID, request ID, client tuple, byte offset, chunk count, and heartbeat count
oracle_contract: unchanged B completes through the canonical synchronous server when no A streams occupy workers
every stable A stream is tied to an authoritative worker slot and advancing heartbeat or durable byte-offset state
with all slots pinned, B remains undispatched for lack of an available worker while the original streams and server stay healthy
after normal stream closure, unchanged B immediately acquires a worker and succeeds through the same endpoint
